packs.name: The Steam Clock
packs.description: A sunlit woodland clearing where an old Steam Clock ticks over Badger's favourite patch of moss.

clearing.name: Forest Clearing
clearing.text: The old Steam Clock ticks among the trees. Its bell can be rung. Badger rests on warm moss.
clearing.idiolect: I'm a sunlit clearing in the woods. An old steam clock stands on my mossy stones. A reflection between my roots leads back the way visitors came. Badger's favourite patch of moss is here.
lines: Sun on the moss, warm in one patch.
Roots, and a reflection between them.

stage.alt: The old Steam Clock stands on mossy stones in a sunlit clearing.

sound.label: Ring the Steam Clock
sound.text: {actor} rings the Steam Clock's bell. The sound rolls between the trees.

badger.name: Grumpy Badger
badger.text: Comically touchy. Very attached to his warm patch of moss.
badger.idiolect: Grumpy Badger. That's me. This warm moss is mine and I was asleep on it. Every visitor is a theft of my nap. Noise stopped, rest restored, that's all I want. Not an adventure. Not a new friend. If you ask me something straight, I'll tell you what I know, grudgingly, and then you can go.
lines: The way back? Through the roots. There. Now go.
Ring that again and see what happens.
Quiet is all I asked for. All.
Three winters I slept through. One visitor and I'm up.
The clock hisses. I hiss back. We get along.
You've had your answer. The moss hasn't had its badger.
Warm patch, right there. Mine. Still mine.

tastes.likes: Warm moss and an uninterrupted nap
tastes.reason: Badger considers this patch of moss his own.
tastes.noise: {actor} rang a bell beside his warm patch of moss.

temperament.woken: Badger wakes from a very satisfactory nap, looking mildly offended.
temperament.disturbed: Badger opens his eyes and flattens his ears at the noise.

asleep.alt: Grumpy Badger asleep beside the clock.
asleep.label: Wake gently
asleep.note: Asleep on the moss. A direct greeting would wake me.

awake.alt: Grumpy Badger, awake and looking put out.
awake.note: Still grumpy about my interrupted nap.

irritated.want: Some quiet after all that noise
irritated.note: Furious at the noise. I want quiet, now.

bridge.description: Two bell rings at Black pond fold its reflection onto the Steam Clock clearing. A bell sounding at either end keeps the way back open.

signal.offer: {actor} rings the Bell again. The Steam Clock answers through the water.
progress: A distant clock answers the bell. Its echo hangs over the pond, waiting for a second ring.
signal.hint: The Steam Clock answers. Ring again to find it.
signal.complete: The second ring folds the pond's reflection. In the water, a forest clearing and an old Steam Clock come into view.

crossings.closed: The reflected clearing fades from the pond.

scenery.open: A bell is sounding, and the dark reflection between the roots opens onto Black pond.
scenery.closed: The roots show only moss: no path to Black pond is visible. Ring the clock's bell to reopen the crossing.

crossings.opened: A dark reflection between the roots opens onto Black pond.
crossings.closed: The bells fall silent. The path to Black pond disappears between the roots; the Steam Clock's bell can reopen it.
